claim_boundary: Same-context internal hostile review of protocol, code, provenance, chronology, parent scope and manuscript only. This is not independent review or peer review and creates no semantic, structural-signal, training, inference or break-even result.

findings.disposition: Resolved by narrowing the historical result to lexical/tag controls and freezing a BGE cross-encoder successor control.
findings.finding: The v2 evaluator's Jaccard features are transparent conformance controls, not a strongest-feasible modern semantic control.

findings.disposition: Resolved: exact repository revision, six file sizes/hashes, implementation hash, content projection and per-pair hash contract are frozen.
findings.finding: A model name or unbound score vector would permit asset substitution and content drift.

findings.disposition: Resolved: candidate invariant/boundary proposals, annotations, quadrants and outcomes are excluded; all 16 actual v2.1 items render successfully in tests.
findings.finding: Feeding curator structural proposals to the semantic control would leak the challenger representation into the baseline.

findings.disposition: Resolved by a machine-readable applicability freeze: Skill-It/MASS are training-selection parents; SWIFT is an inference workflow parent only with an executable operator interface.
findings.finding: Calling static dependency overlap Skill-It/MASS or graph similarity SWIFT would unfairly weaken the parents.

findings.disposition: Preserved as an external execution blocker. The descriptor attempt returns CANNOT_CHECK with zero scores and authorization false.
findings.finding: The exact 2.27-GB model file and accompanying assets are not staged in the bounded environment.

findings.disposition: Resolved in the authority language: the reranker is a non-structural content relevance control, not a semantic-equivalence or mechanistic oracle.
findings.finding: A relevance-trained cross-encoder score must not be promoted to structural or theorem authority.

findings.disposition: Preserved explicitly. The provenance receipt distinguishes locally hashed small files from LFS registry metadata and requires local re-verification after staging.
findings.finding: Registry LFS hashes are authoritative metadata but have not yet been checked against locally staged full assets.

findings.disposition: Resolved: ready descriptors are rejected unless their timestamp strictly predates the first external label completion and all label-access attestations are false.
findings.finding: Computing or selecting the semantic descriptor after labels are visible would break candidate/evaluator chronology.

findings.disposition: Preserved: this report self-identifies as same-context internal review and grants no independent-review authority.
findings.finding: A same-session hostile pass is useful but cannot count as independent scientific review.

next_discriminator: Stage and locally hash-verify the exact model assets, generate the content-bound descriptor before any external annotation completion, then obtain genuinely external annotation/adjudication/provenance evidence before running the successor signal gate.
